sentences.text: There is no dispute about that fact that it is an old matter of the year 2012, in which the applicant was summoned vide order dated 04.07.2012 to face trial.
On 16.12.2016, charges have been framed against the applicant.
Thereafter, on account of his non-appearance, non-bailable warrant has been issued against the applicant in the year 2018.

Thereafter, repeated orders for issuance of process under Section 82 Cr.P.C. were also issued but the applicant did not appear and challenged the subsequent order of non-bailable warrant dated 04.04.2023.
Perusal of the order-sheet shows that the applicant is not appearing before the trial court since long.
Considering the facts of the case, I do not find any illegality in the impugned non-bailable warrant dated 04.04.2023.
Hence, I do not find any good ground to interfere in the matter.
4. In view of the above, the application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is dismissed.
